design_overview: UniStudy is designed as a modern, student-focused mobile application with clean visual hierarchy and intuitive navigation. The design prioritizes quick access to study notes, seamless group collaboration, and easy content discovery. The interface uses a card-based layout with clear CTAs, ensuring students can efficiently share notes, join study groups, and communicate with peers. The color scheme reflects academic professionalism while maintaining approachability through soft gradients and rounded corners.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Primary landing screen showing personalized content, recent activity, and quick actions for students

key_components.name: Top Header Bar
key_components.styling: White background with subtle shadow, contains app logo on left and notification bell icon on right, height 64px
key_components.interaction: Bell icon navigates to notifications screen

key_components.name: Welcome Banner
key_components.styling: Gradient background from primary to secondary color, white text, rounded corners 16px, padding 20px, displays user name and motivational message
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive, displays personalized greeting

key_components.name: Quick Actions Row
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrollable row with 4 action cards, each with icon, label, white background, shadow, 12px border radius
key_components.interaction: Upload Notes navigates to upload screen, Browse Notes to notes library, Create Group to group creation, Join Group to group discovery

key_components.name: Recent Notes Section
key_components.styling: Section header 'Recent Notes' in bold, list of 3 note cards with thumbnail, title, subject tag, rating stars, download count
key_components.interaction: Tapping any note card navigates to note detail screen

key_components.name: My Study Groups Section
key_components.styling: Section header 'My Groups' in bold, horizontal scrollable cards showing group name, subject, member count, last activity
key_components.interaction: Tapping group card navigates to group chat screen

key_components.name: Trending Notes Widget
key_components.styling: White card with 'Trending This Week' header, shows top 3 notes with compact layout, fire icon indicator
key_components.interaction: Tapping widget expands to full trending notes list

key_components.name: Search Bar
key_components.styling: Light gray background, rounded 24px, search icon on left, placeholder 'Search notes, groups, subjects...', height 48px
key_components.interaction: Tapping opens search screen with filters

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: White background, 4 tabs with icons and labels, active tab in primary color, inactive in gray, height 72px
key_components.interaction: Switches between Home, Notes, Groups, Profile screens

screens.user_flow: Entry point after login. Users can navigate to Notes Library, Group Discovery, Upload Notes, or Profile from here. Bottom nav provides persistent access to main sections.

screens.name: Notes Library
screens.purpose: Browse, search, and filter all available study notes shared by students across subjects

key_components.name: Header with Back Button
key_components.styling: White background, back arrow on left, 'Study Notes' title centered, filter icon on right, shadow below
key_components.interaction: Back button returns to Home, filter icon opens filter modal

key_components.name: Search Input
key_components.styling: Light background, rounded 12px, search icon, placeholder 'Search by title, subject, or keyword', margin 16px
key_components.interaction: Real-time search filtering as user types

key_components.name: Subject Filter Chips
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrollable chips: All, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, etc. Active chip has primary background, inactive has border only
key_components.interaction: Tapping chip filters notes by subject category

key_components.name: Sort Dropdown
key_components.styling: Small button with 'Sort by: Recent' text and down arrow, light gray background, positioned right side
key_components.interaction: Opens dropdown with options: Recent, Most Downloaded, Highest Rated, Alphabetical

key_components.name: Notes Grid List
key_components.styling: Vertical scrollable list of note cards, each card shows thumbnail preview, title, subject tag, uploader name, rating (stars), download count, date uploaded
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to Note Detail screen

key_components.name: Upload FAB
key_components.styling: Floating action button, circular, primary color with white plus icon, positioned bottom right with shadow, 56px diameter
key_components.interaction: Opens upload notes screen

key_components.name: Empty State
key_components.styling: Centered illustration with text 'No notes found' and 'Try adjusting your filters' subtitle, shown when search returns no results
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive placeholder

key_components.name: Loading Skeleton
key_components.styling: Animated gray placeholder cards mimicking note card layout while content loads
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive loading state

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: White background, 4 tabs, Notes tab highlighted in primary color
key_components.interaction: Switches between main app sections

screens.user_flow: Accessed from Home via bottom nav or Browse Notes action. Users can search, filter, and tap notes to view details. Upload FAB allows quick note submission. Returns to Home via back button or bottom nav.

screens.name: Note Detail
screens.purpose: Display comprehensive information about a specific study note including preview, ratings, reviews, and download option

key_components.name: Header with Actions
key_components.styling: Transparent overlay on note preview, back arrow left, share icon and bookmark icon right, white icons with subtle shadow
key_components.interaction: Back returns to Notes Library, share opens share sheet, bookmark saves note to favorites

key_components.name: Note Preview Image
key_components.styling: Full-width preview of first page of note, aspect ratio 16:9, subtle gradient overlay at bottom
key_components.interaction: Tapping opens full-screen preview mode

key_components.name: Note Title and Metadata
key_components.styling: White card with note title in large bold text, subject tag chip, uploader name with small avatar, upload date, file type badge (PDF/DOCX)
key_components.interaction: Tapping uploader name navigates to their profile

key_components.name: Rating Summary
key_components.styling: Horizontal card showing average rating (4.5 stars), total ratings count, download count with icons, light background
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive summary display

key_components.name: Description Section
key_components.styling: White card with 'Description' header and note description text, expandable if text is long, 'Read more' link
key_components.interaction: Read more expands full description

key_components.name: Download Button
key_components.styling: Full-width primary color button with white text 'Download Note', rounded 12px, height 56px, prominent shadow
key_components.interaction: Downloads note file and increments download count

key_components.name: Reviews Section Header
key_components.styling: Section divider with 'Reviews' text and 'Write Review' link button on right
key_components.interaction: Write Review opens review modal

key_components.name: Reviews List
key_components.styling: Vertical list of review cards, each showing user avatar, name, star rating, review text, date posted, helpful count
key_components.interaction: Scrollable list, can mark reviews as helpful

key_components.name: Related Notes
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrollable row of related note cards from same subject, compact layout with thumbnail and title
key_components.interaction: Tapping related note navigates to its detail screen

screens.user_flow: Accessed by tapping note card from Notes Library or Home. Users can preview, download, bookmark, share, or write reviews. Back button returns to previous screen. Related notes allow continued browsing.

screens.name: Study Groups
screens.purpose: Discover, browse, and join study groups organized by subject and topic for collaborative learning

key_components.name: Header with Search
key_components.styling: White background, 'Study Groups' title on left, search icon on right, subtle bottom border
key_components.interaction: Search icon opens group search overlay

key_components.name: My Groups Tab Bar
key_components.styling: Two tabs: 'My Groups' and 'Discover', active tab has primary color underline, inactive is gray
key_components.interaction: Switches between joined groups and group discovery views

key_components.name: Create Group Button
key_components.styling: Secondary color button with plus icon and 'Create New Group' text, full width, rounded 12px, margin 16px
key_components.interaction: Opens group creation form screen

key_components.name: Subject Filter Chips
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrollable subject chips similar to Notes Library, active state in primary color
key_components.interaction: Filters groups by subject category

key_components.name: Groups List
key_components.styling: Vertical scrollable list of group cards, each showing group name, subject tag, description preview, member count, admin name, last activity time
key_components.interaction: Tapping group card navigates to Group Detail screen

key_components.name: Group Card Join Button
key_components.styling: Small 'Join' button on each group card, accent color, rounded, appears only for groups not yet joined

key_components.name: Active Members Indicator
key_components.styling: Small badge on group cards showing number of active members online now with green dot indicator
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive status indicator

key_components.name: Empty State
key_components.styling: Centered illustration with 'No groups yet' message and 'Create your first study group' CTA button

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: White background, Groups tab highlighted in primary color

screens.user_flow: Accessed via bottom nav Groups tab. Users can toggle between My Groups and Discover tabs, filter by subject, join groups, or create new ones. Tapping group navigates to Group Chat screen.

screens.name: Group Chat
screens.purpose: Real-time messaging interface for study group members to discuss topics, share resources, and collaborate

key_components.styling: White background, back arrow left, group name and subject tag center, info icon and settings icon right, shadow below
key_components.interaction: Back returns to Groups list, info icon shows group details modal, settings for admin controls

key_components.name: Announcement Banner
key_components.styling: Light yellow background, bell icon, announcement text preview, 'View All' link, dismissible close button
key_components.interaction: Tapping banner expands full announcement, close button dismisses

key_components.name: Messages List
key_components.styling: Scrollable chat messages, user messages right-aligned in primary color bubbles, other messages left-aligned in gray bubbles, each with avatar, name, timestamp
key_components.interaction: Scrollable, auto-scrolls to newest message, long-press for message options

key_components.name: Date Dividers
key_components.styling: Centered gray text showing date (Today, Yesterday, specific date) between message groups
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive visual separator

key_components.name: Typing Indicator
key_components.styling: Small gray bubble showing 'Sarah is typing...' with animated dots when someone is composing
key_components.interaction: Non-interactive real-time status

key_components.name: Message Input Bar
key_components.styling: White background, rounded text input with placeholder 'Type a message...', plus icon left for attachments, send icon right in primary color
key_components.interaction: Plus icon opens attachment options, send button posts message to group

key_components.name: Quick Actions Row
key_components.styling: Horizontal row above input with quick action buttons: Share Note, Schedule Meeting, Create Poll, subtle icons and labels
key_components.interaction: Each button opens respective action modal

key_components.name: Member Avatars Strip

key_components.name: Scroll to Bottom FAB

key_components.name: Stats Row
key_components.styling: Horizontal row with 3 stat cards: Notes Uploaded, Groups Joined, Total Downloads, each with number and label, light background

key_components.name: Edit Profile Button

key_components.name: Content Tabs

key_components.name: My Notes List

key_components.name: My Groups List

key_components.interaction: Tapping group navigates to Group Chat screen

key_components.name: Account Actions
key_components.styling: List of action items: Saved Notes, Notifications, Help & Support, Privacy Policy, Log Out, each with icon and chevron

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: White background, Profile tab highlighted in primary color
key_components.interaction: Switches between main app sections

screens.user_flow: Accessed via bottom nav Profile tab. Users can view their stats, edit profile, manage uploaded notes, view joined groups, and access account settings. Navigation to other screens via action items or bottom nav.

responsive_design: The design follows mobile-first principles with breakpoints at 375px (mobile), 768px (tablet), and 1024px (desktop). On larger screens, the layout transitions to a two-column grid for notes and groups, with persistent side navigation replacing bottom tabs. Cards maintain max-width of 400px and center on wide screens. Touch targets remain minimum 44x44px across all devices. Typography scales proportionally using rem units.
accessibility: All interactive elements meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards with minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for text. Touch targets are minimum 44x44px. Screen reader labels provided for all icons and images. Focus indicators visible on all interactive elements. Color is not the only means of conveying information (icons and text accompany color coding). Form inputs include clear labels and error messages. Keyboard navigation supported for web version.
animations: Subtle micro-interactions enhance usability: button press states with 0.2s scale animation, card tap with gentle elevation increase, page transitions slide horizontally with 0.3s ease-out, bottom sheet slides up with spring animation, loading states use skeleton screens with shimmer effect, toast notifications fade in/out with 0.3s opacity transition, tab switches with smooth underline slide animation, pull-to-refresh with elastic bounce effect.
icons: Consistent icon set using outline style from Feather Icons or similar. Primary icons include: home (house outline), search (magnifying glass), user (person outline), settings (gear), bell (notification), bookmark (ribbon), heart (favorite), filter (funnel), plus (add/create), edit (pencil), trash (delete), share (arrow pointing out). Icons are 24x24px by default, scalable to 20px or 28px based on context. All icons use currentColor to inherit text color for easy theming.
